hands.note: RECONCILED in wave H. (1) The 33rd Regiment: all 2,200 here until 12-12 20:00; then the 2nd and 3rd Battalions and the HQ (1,448) go to bs-1210-zhongshan (hands.out); the 1st Battalion (700) and the gun company (52, guns on the second peak) stay as the mountain garrison with the 9th Regt battalion (west spur). (2) ev-1212-zhongshanmen-shelling: this bake owns the GUNS (jp-33-rg, second peak, jp-030) and replaces the event; bs-1210-zhongshan owns the WALL (breach, gate top, fall at 15:00) and also replaces it. The Chinese leave through the west edge of the box (their route to 下关 is not sourced).

picture_target.t_note: wave H fix round: was 12-12 17:00 (the mark's hour). At 17:00 the sun is down and the oblique and near stills of the stills script are black (nothing readable); 16:30 is inside the mark's 120 minute window (15:00-19:00 holds all three sources) and inside the peak tempo window 15:00-18:00, and the light is still there. The mark summit_taken stays at 17:00.
picture_target.label: 核实
picture_target.src: plan wall card B2 "那座山": the most intense moment is the evening of 12 Dec, the Japanese take the 488 m main peak hill by hill, one company at a time, at the end of a three-day climb (the red line climbs the ridge, the blue bars fall back one after another, then a fan of gun fire from the mountain to the East Gate); sources 15:00 / dusk / 18:00 (jp-032, F23)

marks.text_zh: 12月8日 日军炮兵开始炮击老虎洞一线
marks.text_en: 8 Dec: the Japanese guns begin to shell the Tiger's Cave line
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: F03, en.wikipedia and Shi Huaiyu (the day is 核实; the hour 推测)

marks.text_zh: 约17时 东麓枪炮声大作，日军步兵第一次冲击被火力压回
marks.text_en: About 17:00 firing breaks out at the east foot; the first infantry attack is thrown back
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: F03, en.wikipedia ref 112 (about 17:00 per the battle note; the unit is 推测)

marks.text_zh: 12月9日 烟幕与空袭再攻老虎洞
marks.text_en: 9 Dec: smoke and air bombing for the second attack on the Tiger's Cave
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: jp-053 (the hours 推测; aircraft type and count 未核实; ev-1210-zijinshan-air)

marks.text_zh: 第5团损失过半，放弃这座暴露的山头，退回主阵地
marks.text_en: The 5th Regiment, which lost more than half its men, gives up the exposed hill and falls back to the main positions
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: F03, en.wikipedia ref 113 (the loss is attributed; the hour is 推测)

marks.text_zh: 12月10日 13:00 日军炮兵在紫金山麓（照片图注）
marks.text_en: 10 Dec 13:00: Japanese artillery at the foot of the mountain (photo caption)
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: Commons caption 支那事変写真帖 (the hour as printed; licence 未核实; the image was not viewed)

marks.text_zh: 13:30 第33联队开始攻山，一次只能用一个中队（约150人）
marks.text_en: 13:30: the 33rd Regiment begins to attack the mountain; only one company (about 150 men) can act at a time
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: F23 (testimony of 羽田武夫 via Ncp34; hour as printed)

marks.text_zh: 第3大队夺取东端227.5米高地
marks.text_en: The 3rd Battalion takes the 227.5 m height at the east end
marks.label: 核实

marks.text_zh: 16:00 第2大队夺取382.5米高地（第二峰）
marks.text_en: 16:00: the 2nd Battalion takes the 382.5 m height (the second peak)
marks.label: 核实

marks.text_zh: 12月11日 第16师团夺取南麓的西山（外围工事）
marks.text_en: 11 Dec: the 16th Division takes the 西山 on the south slope (the outer works)
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: raw_fights_south_east#8 (no hour: 推测; the memoir keeps the upper works Chinese to the night of 12 Dec)

marks.text_zh: 12月12日 炮兵在第二峰向中山门开炮
marks.text_en: 12 Dec: guns on the second peak open fire on Zhongshan Gate
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: jp-030, en.wikipedia; the hour 10:00 is the timeline's (推测)

marks.text_zh: 约15时 中山门以南一大段城墙在炮火下坍塌
marks.text_en: About 15:00 a large section of the wall south of Zhongshan Gate gives way under the guns
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: jp-030, F22; wall.json breaches zhongshan-s (the hour, place and width are 推测); the gate is outside the box

marks.text_zh: 主峰下的近身肉搏开始
marks.text_en: Hand-to-hand fighting for the works below the main peak begins
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: F23, raw_fights_south_east#9 (the hour is 推测)

marks.text_zh: 12日傍晚前后 日军夺取488米主峰（15:00、黄昏、18:00三说）
marks.text_en: Around dusk on 12 Dec the Japanese take the 488 m main peak (three sources: 15:00, dusk, 18:00)
marks.label: 核实

marks.text_zh: 17:20 山上起火（场景的山火；起因未核实）
marks.text_en: 17:20: the mountain catches fire (the scene's own fire; cause unsourced)
marks.label: 未核实
marks.src: timeline fire-1212-zijinshan; battle_zijinshan.md (争议 2: no source found for a mountain fire on the night of 12 Dec); the bake lights no fire of its own

marks.text_zh: 入夜 守军残部撤离，西山阵地夜间撤走
marks.text_en: At night the defenders' remnants slip away and the 西山 position is evacuated
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: F26, F31, Shi Huaiyu (the hour and the route are 推测)
